name: points-progress
description: 完成度横条：进度填充动画 + 大百分比数字
css: #tpl-points-progress { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding: 0 8vw; background: var(--ground, #0a0a1a); gap: 2.6vh; } .pp-num { font-size: 12vh; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--ink, #f0f0f5); line-height: 1; } .pp-track { height: 3vh; background: currentColor; opacity: .14; position: relative; border-radius: 2vh; overflow: hidden; } .pp-fill { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--ink, #f0f0f5); transform-origin: left center; } .pp-label { font-size: 2.2vh; opacity: .72; color: var(--ink, #f0f0f5); }
timeline: var _ppn = document.querySelector("{tpl} .pp-num");var _ppv = parseFloat(String(_ppn.textContent).replace(/[^0-9.]/g, "")) || 100;var _ppf = document.querySelector("{tpl} .pp-fill");_ppf.style.width = _ppv + "%";tl.fromTo("{tpl} .pp-num", { opacity: 0, y: 30 }, { opacity: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "power2.out" }, {start});tl.fromTo("{tpl} .pp-fill", { scaleX: 0 }, { scaleX: 1, duration: Math.min(1.4, {dur} * 0.55), ease: "power2.inOut" }, {start} + 0.3);tl.fromTo("{tpl} .pp-label", { opacity: 0 }, { opacity: 1, duration: 0.4 }, {start} + 0.6);
